description: Network and device vulnerability scanning. Off by default; Wazuh already covers installed packages.
_doc: Off by default and worth leaving off unless the firm has network gear or printers to scan. Needs two env keys added by hand before it will build - see modules/scan/env.schema.

preUninstallExport.description: pg_dump of every database, a tarball per volume, host state, config and an EXPORT-MANIFEST.json. Runs BEFORE anything is removed; skipping takes a typed confirmation.

license.name: PolyForm Internal Use 1.0.0
license.note: Free with any licensed Vibe product for a firm's own use. The MSP/multi-tenant tier - monitoring OTHER firms - is the only paid one. Third-party components keep their own licenses.

health.doc: Run from the module's directory in the installer checkout; exit 0 means healthy. Several modules have no HTTP surface to probe, and pulse's probe must assert the pinned build is the one running rather than merely that something answered.
